name: Infrastructure (EPC, roads, construction)
subsectors: Non-road EPC (power T&D, water, oil and gas, solar)

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: INFRASTRUCTURE: Project awarding remains muted in 2QFY27
mofsl_2qfy27.read: NHAI awarded only ~596km against an FY27 target of 5,140km, delaying appointed dates, yet coverage revenue (ex-IRB and AEL) rose 45% YoY (GRIL +64% on a low base, KNR -3%). Gross margin fell 434bp and EBITDA margin 64bp YoY (to 9.4%) on high costs; IRB revenue/EBITDA grew 8%/14% on BOT income and InvIT gains, AEL 75%/67% on copper and airports. NHAI set an INR300-350b asset monetisation target via TOT and InvITs (17 assets, 1,693km); FASTag value rose ~17% in Oct'26.

unit_economics: Revenue = opening order book x execution rate (progress on appointed projects); EBITDA = revenue x (gross margin after commodity/subcontract cost - overheads); PAT burdened by interest on working capital and equity-funded BOT/HAM assets

price_drivers.why: NHAI awarded only ~596km of a 5,140km FY27 target, so inflow decides FY28 revenue visibility.
Companies with healthy backlogs and strong balance sheets are favoured in a muted award cycle.
Revenue +45% YoY despite weak awarding shows backlog execution, but appointed-date delays cap growth.
Gross margin fell 434bp YoY; bitumen, steel and cement pass-through lag in fixed-price contracts.
NHAI's INR300-350b TOT/InvIT programme releases equity from BOT/HAM assets and eases leverage.

kpis.name: Order inflow
kpis.definition: Value of new orders won in the period, by segment (road, non-road, export)
kpis.formula: reported; or change in order book + revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Inflow replenishes the book; with NHAI awarding ~596km against a 5,140km target, any large award re-rates road EPC names, and diversification into non-road orders (KNR, GRIL) shows resilience.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'order inflow' filter; transcripts for pipeline; Motilal Oswal results update tables (8 quarters)
kpis.estimate_source: No Bloomberg inflow field; company inflow guidance on calls and broker models
kpis.traps: L1 status vs LoA vs appointed date; bids won but not yet in book; inflow includes variations.

kpis.name: Order book and book-to-bill
kpis.definition: Unexecuted order book and its ratio to trailing-12M revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Book-to-bill of 2.5-3x signals 2-3 years of revenue; MOFSL favours companies with healthy backlogs given weak awarding.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'order book' filter; get_financials for revenue; transcripts
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Sales FY27-FY29 as cross-check; company guidance on order-book composition
kpis.traps: Orders not yet appointed (zero date) inflate the book; HAM and BOT projects sit separately; slow-moving legacy orders.

kpis.name: Execution rate (revenue / opening order book)
kpis.definition: Revenue booked in the year as % of opening order book
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Speed of conversion drives revenue growth and working capital; coverage revenue +45% YoY in 2QFY27 shows healthy execution that awarding gaps will eventually test.
kpis.history_source: get_financials revenue; order book from get_investor_presentation; derive 5+ years
kpis.estimate_source: Management revenue guidance (L&T FY27 revenue and inflow growth 10-12%); get_consensus_estimates Sales
kpis.traps: Monsoon seasonality (Q2 weakest); appointed-date delays; revenue including pass-through materials.

kpis.name: EBITDA margin and gross margin
kpis.definition: EBITDA and gross margin of the construction business, ex BOT/InvIT gains
kpis.formula: EBITDA / revenue; (revenue - raw material and subcontract) / revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Coverage EBITDA margin dipped 64bp YoY to 9.4% and gross margin 434bp; L&T core E&C margin target is ~7.8%, so price-linked escalation clauses decide earnings.
kpis.history_source: get_financials 5+ years; Motilal Oswal results tables; get_investor_presentation margin filters
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA FY27-FY29; company margin guidance on calls
kpis.traps: IRB EBITDA includes toll and InvIT gains; AEL EBITDA driven by copper trading; fixed-price contracts lag commodity moves.

kpis.name: Net working capital days
kpis.definition: Net working capital including retention money and unbilled revenue as days of revenue
kpis.formula: (receivables + unbilled + inventory - payables) / revenue x 365; L&T uses NWC-to-revenue under 10%
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Government payment delays and retention money tie up cash; L&T targets NWC-to-revenue under 10%, and improvement flows to net debt and interest cost.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet and cash flow 5+ years; get_investor_presentation NWC filter
kpis.estimate_source: Management NWC targets on calls; broker models; no consensus
kpis.traps: Cut-off at balance date; inclusion of BOT/HAM receivables; mobilisation advances flatter NWC.

kpis.name: HAM/BOT equity commitment and monetisation
kpis.definition: Equity invested and pending in HAM/BOT projects and proceeds from asset sales to InvITs
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Equity lock-up constrains growth and lifts leverage; NHAI's INR300-350b TOT/InvIT target and IRB InvIT gains show how capital is recycled.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts and get_qa; get_investor_presentation 'equity' and 'monetisation' filters; get_financials investments
kpis.estimate_source: Management equity-requirement guidance and broker SOTP models
kpis.traps: InvIT gains inflate EBITDA/PAT (IRB); stake sales shift reported leverage.

kpis.name: Net debt to equity and interest cover
kpis.definition: Consolidated net debt (ex non-recourse project debt) over equity, with EBITDA/interest
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Strong balance sheets are what MOFSL favours in a muted award cycle; leverage determines ability to bid for BOT/HAM projects.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet; transcripts for debt guidance
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models and company guidance; get_consensus_estimates for PAT/EPS only
kpis.traps: Project-level non-recourse debt vs standalone; mobilisation advances treated as liabilities.

kpis.name: NHAI awarding (km) and highway ordering pace
kpis.definition: Kilometres of highway projects awarded and appointed against annual target
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Single best lead indicator for road EPC inflow; 596km in 2QFY27 vs a 5,140km target explains subdued order wins.
kpis.history_source: Broker sector notes in the report library via list_library_documents; MOFSL strategy review
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; ministry targets and broker projections
kpis.traps: Awarded vs appointed date; bundling of projects into larger packages.

macro_inputs.series: NHAI awarding pace and FASTag collections
macro_inputs.source: Broker sector notes in the report library

valuation_anchor: P/E and EV/EBITDA on forward earnings with SOTP for BOT/HAM assets at equity value and InvIT monetisation
watch_next_quarter: Whether NHAI awarding picks up against the 5,140km FY27 target, progress on the INR300-350b asset monetisation (17 assets), and whether gross margin recovers from the 434bp YoY contraction.
